name: @mas/desktop-electron
description: Thin Electron shell for Person360, loading the static export from apps/web/out

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/rename.mjs && cross-env MAS_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/rename.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
